title: NGS Library Prep for Targeted Sequencing of DNA Methylation Patterns in Cell-Free DNA
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Distribute DNA and buffer
steps.instruction: Add the cell‑free DNA sample and the CT conversion buffer into the designated wells of the PCR plate.

steps.title: Pause for deck lights
steps.instruction: Wait until the OT‑2 deck lights signal before continuing to the next operations.

steps.title: Process sample: desulphonate, clean, elute, transfer
steps.instruction: Perform desulphonation, bead‑based cleanup, elution, and then move the eluate into a fresh PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Desulphonate the bisulfite‑treated DNA according to the kit instructions.
Clean the sample using magnetic beads as described in the protocol.
Elute the purified DNA from the beads.
Transfer the eluate to a new PCR plate.
